[[File:Pros2187.jpg|thumb|align|right|Cell 2187]]
'''Cell 2187''' was a detention cell located aboard the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ship]] ''[[Prosecutor]]''. 387 days after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], when [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] undertook an exploration of the ruined vessel, [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]] was injured and captured by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]]. He was held in the cell until his comrades broke into the ship's detention block, killing his captors and freeing him.<ref name="Commando">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The detention cell shares its name with [[Wikipedia:21-87|''21-87'']], a short film directed by [[Wikipedia:Arthur Lipsett|Arthur Lipsett]] and which inspired [[George Lucas]] to make the film [[Wikipedia:THX-1138|''THX-1138'']].<ref name="SWTwitter">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1248749462773612545|''[[Star Wars]]''|date=2020-04-11|quote=Finn's stormtrooper number was FN-2187. The # is a homage to cell 2187 located in detention block AA-23 on the Death Star, the cell of Princess Leia in A New Hope. Cell 2187 from ANH is a ref. to "21-87" a National Film Board of Canada short that inspired a young George Lucas.|archivedate=20210504201436}}</ref>
